t: The FloPlast Solvent Weld Plain-End Pipe provides an effective solution for robust drainage systems. Designed to connect 2 x sockets in a soil and vent system. Constructed from uPVC, it is ideal for domestic, commercial and industrial applications. Suitable for temperatures up to 76, or 100°C for 2 minutes intermittently.
b: For use with FloPlast Solvent Cement
